result_text:
The "Undefined Team" remainder now only collects active contributors. In `getAllTeams()` in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`, I added `contributor.getContributor().isActive()` to the condition that puts a contributor into the remainder.

Contributors with no latest-commit date still count as active, because `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange` returns true for a blank date. The configured-team branch is untouched, so those teams keep all their members.

The `Landscape*` tests in `codeanalyzer` pass. I didn't add a test for the dormant-contributor case.
